Hi Emily — welcome and thanks for the details.

Quick answers:
- We can usually escalate PLG credit requests for qualifying self-serve signups.
- For a 2-week PoC at your scale, $2k is within quick-approval bounds; larger requests (>$2k) need a short review.
- I can provision an initial $2k immediately and escalate the remaining amount for manager approval if you want the full $5k.

Can you confirm whether the team will be using the hosted API (no dedicated VPC) and whether you need increased rate limits for burst traffic? Also, please confirm billing contact (is billing@quickstartquest.com the right address).

If that works, I can provision the $2k now and loop in Camila + Ben to review the additional $3k. Would you be available for a 20-min sync today or tomorrow?
